def _plan_epoch(c, preds, thresholds):
    slots = c['slots']; flows = c['flows']; groups = c['groups']; windows = c['windows']
    bucket = c['bucket']; class_values = c['class_values']
    S = len(slots); J = len(windows); F = len(flows); G = len(groups)
    B, I = bucket
    times = [r[0] for r in slots]
    scaps = [r[1] for r in slots]
    refills = [r[2] for r in slots]
    W = 1 + J * times[-1]
    value = [windows[j][6] * class_values[preds[j]] for j in range(J)]
    ready = [w[1] for w in windows]
    expires = [w[2] for w in windows]
    flow_of = [w[0] for w in windows]
    passes = [windows[j][5] < thresholds[j] for j in range(J)]
    target = [r[0] for r in flows]
    ceilf = [r[1] for r in flows]
    grpf = [r[2] for r in flows]
    parent = [r[0] for r in groups]
    ceilg = [r[1] for r in groups]

    def node_a(s): return 2 + 3 * s
    def node_b(s): return 3 + 3 * s
    def node_e(s): return 4 + 3 * s
    def node_w(j): return 2 + 3 * S + j
    def node_z(f): return 2 + 3 * S + J + f
    def node_h(g): return 2 + 3 * S + J + F + g
    K = 2 + 3 * S + J + F + G
    ZN = 1

    # eligible pairs in slot-major, window-index order
    eligible = []
    elig_of_j = []   # not needed
    for s in range(S):
        ts = times[s]
        for j in range(J):
            if passes[j] and ready[j] <= ts <= expires[j]:
                eligible.append((s, j))

    # arc metadata in output order
    arc_u = []; arc_v = []; arc_h = []; arc_c = []; arc_kind = []  # kind: 0 normal, 1 flow-lower (index f), 2 ...
    for s in range(S):
        arc_u.append(0); arc_v.append(node_a(s)); arc_h.append(I if s == 0 else refills[s]); arc_c.append(0)
        arc_u.append(node_a(s)); arc_v.append(node_b(s)); arc_h.append(B); arc_c.append(0)
        if s + 1 < S:
            arc_u.append(node_b(s)); arc_v.append(node_a(s + 1)); arc_h.append(B); arc_c.append(0)
        arc_u.append(node_b(s)); arc_v.append(node_e(s)); arc_h.append(scaps[s]); arc_c.append(0)
    n_chain = len(arc_u)
    e_start = n_chain
    for (s, j) in eligible:
        arc_u.append(node_e(s)); arc_v.append(node_w(j)); arc_h.append(1)
        arc_c.append((times[s] - ready[j]) - value[j] * W)
    e_end = len(arc_u)
    w_start = e_end
    for j in range(J):
        arc_u.append(node_w(j)); arc_v.append(node_z(flow_of[j])); arc_h.append(1); arc_c.append(0)
    w_end = len(arc_u)
    f_start = w_end
    for f in range(F):
        tgt = node_h(grpf[f]) if grpf[f] >= 0 else ZN
        arc_u.append(node_z(f)); arc_v.append(tgt); arc_h.append(ceilf[f]); arc_c.append(0)
    f_end = len(arc_u)
    g_start = f_end
    for g in range(G):
        tgt = node_h(parent[g]) if parent[g] >= 0 else ZN
        arc_u.append(node_h(g)); arc_v.append(tgt); arc_h.append(ceilg[g]); arc_c.append(0)
    g_end = len(arc_u)
    zr_idx = g_end
    arc_u.append(ZN); arc_v.append(0); arc_h.append(J); arc_c.append(0)
    M = len(arc_u)
